Its chin, throat, and chest are marked with cream-colored patches; Habitat: Freshwater rivers, slow streams, lakes; Diet: Carnivore: fish eggs, aquatic mammals, birds, fish, crustaceans; Reproduction: Giant otters are nonseasonal breeders, although most births occur during the dry season.
